name: Errol Vance
flavor: A licensed engineer who still reads the defect log himself. Reckons a well-kept airframe owes you nothing and a neglected one takes it out of your schedule.

name: Lena Fischer
flavor: Ran fleet planning for a charter group that changed its aircraft every season. Knows every lessor's delivery desk and gets planes in, and out, in half the time.

name: Marcus Oyelaran
flavor: Twenty years running control centres. Believes most delays are decisions, not weather, and reschedules a rotation faster than anyone can explain why it was late.

name: Priya Raghunathan
flavor: Came up through the cabin and never stopped thinking like it. Rewrote a legacy carrier's onboard standards and made the crew like the new ones better.

name: Dale Mercer
flavor: Spent a career in the back offices of charter airlines, where a head-office cost nobody can name is a cost that gets cut. Brings a red pen and uses it.

name: Hana Okafor
flavor: Ran fuel purchasing for a flag carrier through two price spikes. Knows the banks by first name and pays half what anyone else does to lock a price.

name: Simone Adeyemi
flavor: Structured aircraft debt for a decade before deciding she would rather spend it than arrange it. Lessors return her calls first, and quote her lower.

name: Tomas Lindqvist
flavor: Built a low-cost carrier's network one town at a time: the travel agents, the local papers, the chamber of commerce. New routes fill faster when he's been there first.

name: Inês Carvalho
flavor: Planned a hub carrier's banks for years and can tell you which two cities a connection is really for. Sells the itinerary, not the flight.

name: Kofi Mensah
flavor: Built the fare systems at two airlines that everyone else then copied. Sells the last seat for what it's worth and the first one for more than you'd think.

name: Akira Sato
flavor: Ran overbooking models at a flag carrier where an empty seat was an offence. Believes every spoiled seat was sold to somebody, just not by you.
